instructions:
You are working in the Go repo github.com/labstack/echo/v4 checked out at /echo (module github.com/labstack/echo/v4, go1.16 toolchain). Make ONLY the following edit in /echo/router.go and nothing else.

Bug: when no route matches, `Context.Path()` must return "" (empty string), because `Path()` is documented in context.go as "Path returns the registered path for the handler". Today `Router.Find` unconditionally executes `ctx.path = path` (the *request* path) at its start, so unmatched requests report the requested URL as the route path.

Fix: in `func (r *Router) Find(method, path string, c Context)`, delete the single line

	ctx.path = path

that appears immediately after `ctx := c.(*context)` (currently around line 342). Do NOT delete or change the later `ctx.path = currentNode.ppath` line (around line 484). Do not change any other line: the `path` parameter is still used further down in the function, so nothing else needs to change.

Do not touch any other file. Do not add, modify or delete tests.

Then run and report the raw output of:
- `cd /echo && gofmt -l router.go`
- `cd /echo && go build ./... && go vet ./`
- `cd /echo && go test ./ -count=1 2>&1 | tail -30`
- `cd /echo && git diff -- router.go`

arguments.text: Fixed. `randomBalancer.Next` and `roundRobinBalancer.Next` now return `nil` when the target list is empty (no more `Intn`/divide-by-zero panics), and the proxy middleware returns 503 instead of dereferencing a nil target. Verified with your exact snippets: both return nil, and `Proxy(NewRandomBalancer(nil))` / `Proxy(NewRoundRobinBalancer(nil))` respond 503 without panicking.

Fixed. `Router.Find` no longer pre-seeds the context with the request path, so `c.Path()` is `""` when no route matched (your `/does-not-exist` case) and still the registered pattern (e.g. `/users/:id`) for matches. 404 handling unchanged.

Fixed. `Scheme()` now only accepts `http`/`https` from X-Forwarded-Proto, X-Forwarded-Protocol and X-Url-Scheme, skipping invalid values and falling through to the next header, defaulting to `http`. Your case (Proto: ftp, Url-Scheme: https) now returns `https`; Proto: ftp alone returns `http`.

Confirmed: the map branch of bindData stores only the first value (`v[0]`) and always as a string, so map[string][]string panics and map[string]interface{} gets a bare string. Fixing it to bind the whole value slice for slice/interface destinations.

Confirmed: Group.Use registers catch-all NotFoundHandler routes for every method, so the second group's Use overwrites the first group's GET /group route. Fixing so those catch-all routes never overwrite an already-registered route.

Confirmed: gzip.Writer flushes its 10-byte header even for an empty write, but res.Size stays 0, so the cleanup deletes Content-Encoding and discards the rest, leaving a headerless gzip fragment. Fixing so a real (even empty) write keeps Content-Encoding: gzip and emits a complete stream.
